title: Fonts and the text cache get one home
body:
`State` holds `font`, `menu_font` and `texts: TextCache`. `Font::load(settings.font_size * scale)` and its `palette_size` twin are written at three sites in `compositor.rs`: setup in `run`, `resized` and `settings_changed`. The `TextCache` key is `(String, Face, color)` with no font in it, so two of those sites must also remember `self.texts.clear()`. `Face` is matched twice: `Paint::scene` maps `Chrome` and `Icon` to `font` and `Menu` to `menu_font`, and `TextCache::get` maps `Icon` to `raster_icon`. Each `Font::load` runs `fontdb::Database::load_system_fonts()` and reads the same font file, so a reload does that twice. `Paint` carries `font` and `menu_font` again for its match.

## Proposal

`struct Text { chrome: Font, menu: Font, cache: TextCache }` with `Text::new(&Settings, scale)`, built once at setup and rebuilt at resize and settings change. Rebuilding clears the cache by construction. `Text::get(renderer, face, text, color)` picks font and raster mode in one match. The font data loads once and both sizes come from it.
close_reason: Text in text.rs holds both fonts and the cached textures, built once by Text::new from one read of the font file, in d46cda3.
